id: title:Gilbert09:retry on bare 5xx responses with no parseable body

review.posthog_relevance: Ingestion reliability for Meta Ads warehouse connector; classifies transient 5xx server errors to prevent worker crashes and enable retries.
review.reason: Adds transient error classification and tests for ingestion workers. P1.F1.H1 checks status >= 500; P1.F2.H1 asserts transient behavior. Tests are present, but the actual API call and retry implementation are not in this chunk, so tier 3 is not supported.
review.uncertainty: Tier 3 requires the actual API and retry implementation, not just the helper and tests. Tier 2 is assigned because the transient classification and its tests are implemented and relevant, though the complete ingestion path is not fully demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the retryable error classification or the actual API call, only the helper function and its tests. While the tests demonstrate the intended behavior, the score cannot be assigned without seeing the production code that actually performs the status code check and the retryable error matching. observations.behavior: Adds status code >= 500 check when JSON parsing fails, treating bare 5xx failures as transient.
observations.posthog_connection: Retrying ingestion requests against Meta Ads API when the server returns a 5xx status without a parseable JSON body, rather than treating it as a permanent failure.

observations.behavior: Adds test asserting that unparseable 500 responses are treated as transient.
observations.posthog_connection: Verifies that ingestion workers do not crash and treat unparseable 500 responses as transient, allowing retry attempts.

observations.behavior: Adds test asserting that unparseable 400 responses are treated as non-transient.
observations.posthog_connection: Verifies that ingestion workers do not treat unparseable 400 responses as transient, preventing unnecessary retries for client-side errors.
